text:
elaine: FYI: we're seeing a surge in 502/503 errors for very large-context hosted gen requests (~>10k tokens) in ap-southeast-1 starting 2026-03-23 13:45 UTC. Initial alert from synthetic runner. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1770001111
devin: Looking at node metrics, memory growth is linear with session length—KV cache retention seems to outpace eviction. Repro: run session with incremental prompts up to 15k.
oliver: Marking this P1. CS has received 3 tickets. Opening PagerDuty incident now.
ops-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-5643. Notifying on-call.
devin: Quick mitigation plan: 1) apply short-term request shedding for contexts >12k (return 413 with guidance) 2) route eligible sessions to quantized-medium model (redwood-med-q2) which uses less KV memory 3) increase autoscaler max nodes for ap-southeast-1 group by +20% while we investigate.
elaine: Rolling the routing change and shedding now. Will post deploy id.
ops-bot: Route change deployed (id: deploy-2026-03-23-1302). Traffic rule: if X-Context-Length > 12k -> redwood-med-q2 or 413.
statusbot: Incident created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1770001111 — Investigating.
devin: After routing change, 5xx rate dropped ~72% in ap-southeast-1. We still observe sporadic OOM guards triggered on older node set.
oliver: Kicking off rolling restart for nodes running kernel-opt v2; will drain and replace with kernel-opt v2b which reduces fragmentation. ETA ~15m.
cs-bot: CS: alert sent to impacted customers with suggested workaround (reduce context, or use dedicated plan). Template used: "We're mitigating an issue affecting very long contexts; temporary routing and limits applied. We're available if you need help."
devin: Pushed a runtime patch that trims stale KV entries when session growth rate exceeds threshold. Logs:
```
[2026-03-23T13:58:12Z] kv_trim: session=xyz tokens_removed=3200 reclaimed=900MB
[2026-03-23T13:59:01Z] oom_guard: action=throttle session=def456
```
elaine: Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ops/long-context?orgId=1&var-region=ap-southeast-1
statusbot: Status page updated: "Mitigations applied: traffic routing and request shedding. Monitoring." (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1770001111)
oliver: Action items: 1) eng-runtime to root cause KV TTL/ejection regressions (owner: devin) 2) SRE to review autoscaler granularity for long-lived sessions (owner: oliver) 3) CS to follow up with affected accounts (owner: cs-bot)
elaine: Next update in 30m or on any regression. Thanks all. :pray:
